title: MACS J0025.4-1222: the 2008 composite in its layers

links.label: Lensing mass map alone, TIFF, 4200 x 4143 px

evidence.locator: Caption: MACS J0025 formed after an incredibly energetic collision between two large clusters in almost the plane of the sky; the image shows a clear separation between dark and ordinary matter. Color code: X-ray (purple), lensing (blue), optical (yellow and cyan). The image is 3.2 arcmin across.

The composite in layers as JPEG and TIFF: optical, X-ray and lensing each alone, each 4200 x 4143 px. Measured here against Gaia DR3: 0.04666 arcsec per pixel, where the files' embedded tags say 0.02331.
